0.label: Sun
0.title: Rest & Recover
0.desc: Off-feet recovery day. Stretch, foam roll, walk if you feel good, and get sleep. Show up fresh for Monday.

1.label: Mon
1.title: Easy Run
1.desc: Keep it conversational the whole way. You should be able to speak in full sentences. Build the base without stacking fatigue.

2.label: Tue
2.title: Intervals
2.desc: Warm up easy, then 6 × 400m at a hard but controlled effort with equal jog recovery. Cool down easy to finish.

3.label: Wed
3.title: Cross Train
3.desc: Bike, swim, or a light gym circuit. Keep the effort aerobic — you should finish feeling refreshed, not wiped.

4.label: Thu
4.title: Tempo Run
4.desc: 15 min easy warm-up, then 20 minutes at a comfortably hard pace — short sentences, not paragraphs. Close with a 10 min easy cool-down.

5.label: Fri
5.title: Easy Shakeout
5.desc: Short and light. Loosen the legs, stay relaxed, and save energy for Saturday's long run.

6.label: Sat
6.title: Long Run
6.desc: Steady easy effort. Fuel early, sip often, and finish feeling like you could add another easy kilometre.
